A '''pygmy porlceetin''' was a large, [[Poison/Legends|venomous]], hexapedal creature found on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] would paint their [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|''Nantex''-class territorial defense starfighters]] with [[Color/Legends|green]] highlights that that were similar to markings on the porlceetin.<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />
